This '''individual''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] in the [[Sith Triumvirate]] who lived in the time of the [[Dark Wars]]. He oversaw the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd]] located on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[moon]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].

==Biography==
This [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] joined the [[Sith Triumvirate]] after the [[Jedi Civil War]]. When [[Darth Sion]] and [[Darth Nihilus]] seized control of the triumvirate from [[Kreia|Darth Traya]], he swore allegiance to Nihilus. The Sith Master was in charge of the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], and was responsible for the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes']] education in use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. During the [[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|Second Battle of Onderon]], this Lord, with three other Sith Masters, attempted to perform a ritual around a dark side [[Vergence/Legends|nexus]] to aid [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] troops. When confronted by the allies of<ref name="KotOR II game" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]],<ref name="Note">The character of the Jedi Exile, the protagonist of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', was later confirmed to have been known as Meetra Surik in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.</ref> the Lord tried to persuade them to join the dark side under his teaching. He failed and said that they had chosen [[Death/Legends|death]] instead of power. He was then defeated along with the other Sith forces established on Dxun.<ref name="KotOR II game" />
